title: Omniversal Re-Presentation (CODA-OR): Re-Presentations Transport Rules
description: CODA-OR is the omniversal re-presentation and pair-gluing layer of the CODA stack. Membership in a comparison envelope does not mint authority; an empty authority-support sieve refuses. Lean and Python check non-creation, support-sieve refusal, and a four-case square-defect classification on declared finite diagrams. Do not version the mismatched Zenodo record 20677250; that payload was a MUR manuscript under an OR title. This is the first CODA-titled OR deposit.
notes: Canonical Repository of Record deposit. Zenodo record: https://zenodo.org/records/23025162. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23025162. Manuscript text is CC-BY-4.0; companion code and Lean 4 sources are Apache-2.0.
